entity.description: Check out the pristine Gulf Coast beaches, islands, and back bays on a Dolphin Cruise or Sunset Cruise! Join us as we experience a truly amazing adventure while searching for wild dolphins along our local bays and beaches of Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, and Perdido Key! Dolphins Down Under brings your family closer to nature, and our tour guides are there to tell you all about it. Both of our catamarans have four door-sized glass panels on the bottom of each vessel. This allows for a view of the world below, and a chance to see dolphins and other marine life as they play beneath the surface. We offer Daily Dolphin Cruises and Sunset Cruises, as well as Private Charters for special events! Each glass bottom boat cruise is its own memorable experience, and we encourage you to experience them all. Besides dolphins, you will have the chance to see osprey, great blue herons, stingrays, sea turtles, and many other marine life in our waterways. Let Dolphins Down Under be your boat and dolphin cruise connection today! For your safety and convenience, we supply life jackets for adults and children alike on all our dolphin cruises. Children 8 years of age and under are required by the United States Coast Guard to wear a life jacket. At Dolphins Down Under, safety is our number one priority. Along with safety, your comfort is also important to us. We have a snack and beverage bar, (alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks) for purchase on your cruise. For those small emergencies you may encounter onboard, fear not, we do have a marine restroom! We always appreciate your business and look forward to showing you the beautiful Alabama Gulf Coast!

Explore the Gulf Coast and experience wild dolphins in their natural environment on our popular glass bottom dolphin cruise in Orange Beach. Reserve your spot today!

Enjoy the last light of the day as you look for dolphins and  other marine life aboard our gorgeous glass bottom boat. You just can’t beat an Orange Beach sunset on the water!

PRIVATE BOAT CHARTER

You can charter a private boat(s) for anything from a birthday party to a company party, church outing, school event, or even a family reunion!

Book Private Charter
PRIVATE FISHING CHARTER

Spend the day fishing with Triple Trouble Charters. Target popular Gulf species using trolling and bottom fishing techniques aboard a 46’ sportfishing boat (up to 6 guests). Fully equipped with rods, reels, bait, tackle, and onboard restroom.

Book Private Fishing Charter
BEACH GEAR RENTALS

Rent everything you need for the perfect beach day! Choose individual gear like beach wagons, metal detectors, pinpoint finders, headphones, and sand scooper, or grab the full treasure hunt bundle. Available for full-day rentals up to 5 days of fun in the sun!

Book Beach Gear
COMMON FAQ’S
CAN WE BRING STROLLERS?

Because of safety issues and space availability, we do not allow strollers, infant carriers, or car seats onboard the boats. We will safely store them at our check-in station.

CAN WE BRING DRINKS?

Coolers and outside beverages are not allowed to be brought on the boat. We do provide a variety of alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages available for purchase on the boat.

WILL I GET SEASICK?

The waters in which we operate are generally calm, and the catamaran hulls are very stable.

Learn more
This is our 3rd cruise with Dolphins Down Under, and I can promise you we will continue to book with them for every time we are in the area! They are fantastic! We have seen multiple dolphins on each cruise. It has never been less than amazing! The staff is very friendly too! Best Price Around. Guaranteed Dolphin Sightings. Friendly Staff.

Kenda Summer, Google Review

Everything about this tour was amazing. Captain Drew and Rusty were comedic geniuses. They made everything so incredibly special for my kiddo. The memories we created on this tour are worth more than money could ever pay for. Thank you guys for making our trip extra special, y’all are amazing!

Lindsay Lennard, Facebook Review

I'm delighted to share that we had an absolutely amazing experience on this tour! If you happen to be in or around Orange Beach AL, I highly recommend choosing this tour. We brought our 1 and 3-year-old kids with us, and the entire staff was incredibly kind and helpful. Even though our 1-year-old was a bit uncomfortable with the life vest, the staff ensured that we all felt safe and at ease. They kept the atmosphere light-hearted with jokes and fantastic beach music, and their expertise in spotting and following dolphins was truly impressive. Overall, it was a fantastic experience for our family!

Racquel Deranjic, Google Review

My family and I did the dolphin tours today and they were awesome! Captain Drew and Hannon were so fun! You could tell they were really on the look out for ocean life. We were so lucky to see 3 sea turtles and a few dolphins. I highly recommend, even if you don’t see ocean life, the boat ride is so relaxing (ask my 9 month old how great of a nap he had 😂). Definitely will be back!

Madelyn Hamburg, Facebook Review

Spend the day with Triple Trouble Charters and see what’s biting in Orange Beach! Captain Ricky will be your guide, allowing you to benefit from years of knowledge and experience.
These waters are known for Amberjack, King Mackerel (Kingfish), Spanish Mackerel, Red Snapper, Gray Triggerfish, Vermilion Snapper, Wahoo, Mahi Mahi, Gag Grouper, Scamp Grouper, Mangrove Snapper, and more – with any luck, it won’t take long to hook into some. On these trips, it’s common to troll and bottom fish using light tackle.
If you’re traveling with the family, you will be glad to know that kids are welcome aboard! Children eight years and under must wear life vests, which will be provided if you don’t have your own.
You’ll be dropping lines from a 46’ Hatteras sportfishing vessel that holds up to 6 passengers. It has outriggers and everything else you need for a productive day on the water. There’s a toilet on board for your convenience. Rods, reels, live bait, and tackle are covered by the charter, as well as lures.
You’ll have the help of a First Mate to put you on fish. It’s customary to tip the Mate 15-20% to show your appreciation. Fish cleaning is available for .30 per pound.
There’s no need to buy a fishing license, just show up ready for a good time! Be mindful that some species may have special rules or limited seasons. Simply ask and your captain can tell you more. You can’t go wrong when you bring sunscreen (non-spray), bottled water, a hat and sunglasses. Alcohol is allowed in moderation,
Your trip with Triple Trouble Charters is just a click away, so why not make it happen?
What To Know

Everything needed for a guaranteed good time is provided. That includes, bait, tackle, rods and reels, and fishing licenses, all on the charter of your choice. Our informative and helpful agents in the charter office will provide departure and return times for your charter. Food and beverages are not provided by the boat. However, our Dock Store does carry drinks and sandwiches along with other snack items.

Location: 26619 Perdido Beach Blvd, Orange Beach, AL 36561

Please do not bring glass bottles on your charter!

Costs not included in the initial charter price are fish cleaning (30 cents per pound), customary deckhand tip (15%-20% of the charter).

Rubber-soled shoes are beneficial for fishing.
